base_override.reason: The engine read the filer's thousands-scaled diluted share counts (292,183 for FY2026) as units, inflating OE/share exactly 1,000x and producing a fake Tier S at the 200% IRR cap. All OE legs (OCF, capex, SBC) are filed in dollars and all three median years (FY2024-26) carry the same thousands share scale, so dividing the engine's normalized base by 1,000 corrects it exactly. A shares_override cannot fix this: overrides fill only absent periods and never replace filed values. Full construction and cross-checks in analysis.md (OVERRIDE section).
base_override.source: This run's dcf_numbers.json base_oe_normalized_per_share ($1,355.341859271022) divided by 1,000. Nutanix presents weighted-average shares in thousands: FY2026 10-K/8-K reconciliation prints diluted shares 292,183 (in thousands) with diluted EPS $5.17 on net income $1,506,837 thousand, and the 10-K cover reports 270,570,179 shares outstanding in units; this run's financials_history.csv shows the scale break directly (FY2019 diluted shares 188,595,000 in units vs FY2020 194,719 in thousands).

moat_against: Net dollar-based retention only 106% — weak expansion for a claimed platform
Broadcom (VMware), Microsoft, AWS and HPE bundle the same layer with economics Nutanix cannot match
SBC $357,667,000 in FY2026 (~39% of OCF); basic share count keeps climbing
FY2027 guided headwinds: server supply constraints and elevated hardware prices delaying projects; ~5% workforce restructuring
moat_for: Gartner Leader in distributed hybrid infrastructure; platform migration is a multi-quarter project — real switching friction
Subscription model: $2.55B ARR (+16% YoY), 86-88% gross margins, pricing power evidenced by margin expansion
Broadcom/VMware disruption makes Nutanix the default independent alternative; Dell/Pure/NetApp/Lenovo partnerships widen reach
moat_justification: A genuine platform position in enterprise hybrid-cloud infrastructure with real switching costs (hypervisor + storage + management plane embedded in customer data centers) and 86-88% software-like gross margins, plus a Broadcom/VMware-displacement tailwind — but net dollar-based retention is only 106%, Broadcom/Microsoft/AWS/HPE bundle the same layer, Nutanix owns no distribution channel, and SBC runs ~39% of OCF. Moderate/narrow moat, CAP 8.5 years.
name: Nutanix, Inc.
one_liner: Quality hybrid-cloud platform, moat 5/10 — but at $69.98 the price pre-pays a super-bull decade: weighted IRR 5.7%, IV@15% $16.44; it clears 15% only below ~$16.
